title_clean: The Importance of VIX Curve Inversion in Trading & Investing
summary: Explains India VIX bands (<15 low, 15-30 moderate, >30 high; 85-86 crisis peaks) and why absolute VIX misleads; introduces VIX futures curve inversion - near-term contract below spot - as a short-term extreme-fear bottoming signal, citing March-2023 US bank failures and the then-current US inversion.
lessons: Fear can compound: VIX at 31 in 2008/2020 still went to 85-86; 'buy fear' needs a timing overlay, not just a level.
When the near-term VIX future trades below spot (curve inversion), panic is short-dated - historically a high-probability bottoming zone.
Indian proxy: Nifty futures premium collapsing from ~100 points toward zero/discount marks capitulation; futures discount = extreme bearishness.

title_clean: INFY & TCS Earnings Trade Strategy Simplified
summary: Teaches the earnings straddle framework using live examples: TCS fell ~2% post-results yet short straddlers profited because the ~4% expected move (ATM straddle premium) wasn't exceeded; Infosys priced a ~5.5% move; explains IV shoot-up pre-results and IV crush after.
lessons: The ATM straddle premium as % of spot IS the market's expected move: sellers profit if the actual move stays inside it, buyers only outside it.
Post-results IV crush can hand sellers profit even on a 2% gap because fear premium deflates faster than delta moves.
Check the ADR/US listing reaction after hours before the next Indian session to pre-read the open.

strategies.name: Earnings short straddle (framework)
strategies.construction: Sell ATM call + ATM put just before results; compare combined premium to spot to get expected move
strategies.numbers: TCS: premium ~145 on ~3600 spot (~4%); actual -2% move left short straddle +23 points (~Rs 2,000+/lot on 175 lot size, ~1-1.5% on ~Rs 1-1.5L margin); combined premium 145->120 post-event; Infosys: 40+40=~80 on ~1450 (~5.5% expected move)
strategies.best_regime: When you believe realized move < implied move; high IV into events
strategies.adjustments: Exit or roll after IV crush; use ADR drift as early directional tell
strategies.risks: Gap beyond expected move hits naked shorts hard; assignment/gap risk on single stocks

title_clean: Follow These 4 RULES or DON'T Become Full-Time Trader
summary: Four gates before trading full-time: sufficient capital, knowledge, 6-12 month expense buffer, and no EMIs dependent on trading income. The math: on ~1 crore capital a realistic 30-40% p.a. yields ~40L; quit only if salary is below the ~10L gap between self-trading and delegating. If you must ask, you are not ready.
lessons: Never underwrite fixed obligations (EMIs) with variable trading income.
Benchmark the decision: full-time trading must beat (trading return minus delegation cost) plus your salary - else keep the job and trade long-term options part-time.
The urge to ask 'can I quit?' is itself the answer - confidence doesn't ask.
